summary: Full backend + frontend testing for SUN SWITCH. 18/18 pytest backend tests passed covering auth, public content, leads, site surveys, admin CRUD + publish toggle, dashboard, lead filters/status/CSV export, and settings persistence. Frontend flows verified: splash intro, home hero ('BRIGHTEN YOUR HOME WITH TATA POWER SOLAR.'), Quote lead form (creates lead with SS reference toast), Site Survey form (creates survey with SV reference toast), /admin unauth redirect to /admin/login, admin login redirects to dashboard, dashboard renders stat cards + charts, Leads page shows new leads with status select + export CSV, Products content manager Add dialog/rows/publish toggle work, Settings page loads with pre-populated business data.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~660 lines in a single file; consider splitting into routers (auth, content, leads, admin, uploads) + seed module for maintainability.
No rate limiting on /api/auth/login and /api/public/leads — abuse risk in production.
/api/auth/logout is a no-op (token stays valid in localStorage until expiry) since JWTs are stateless; acceptable for MVP but worth noting.
Password reset token logged to backend logs rather than emailed; fine for MVP but ensure production replaces with email sender.
CORS allow_credentials=True combined with wildcard default '*' origin is technically invalid for browsers; set explicit CORS_ORIGINS in production .env.
/api/admin/content/{name} POST does not validate 'order' or body shape with Pydantic — any dict accepted. Low-risk but could allow garbage fields.
Dashboard aggregates in Python after loading up to 5000 leads — fine now, but switch to MongoDB aggregation at scale.
seed_data_creation: Backend seeds admin, settings, 6 products, 8 services, 4 projects, 12 gallery, 4 testimonials, 6 FAQs on startup. Tests created TEST_* leads/surveys/products (cleaned up where possible).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin routes are /admin/products NOT /admin/content/products (ContentManager mounted directly). Public lead/survey submissions return reference IDs via toast (SSyymmddXXXX / SVyymmddXXXX). JWT token stored in localStorage key 'ss_token'. Splash overlay delays home ~2.9s on first load. All critical data-testid attributes are present and reliable.
